# spinupwp_server (Resource)

A custom server (from any hosting provider) provisioned by SpinupWP over SSH. SpinupWP's SSH key (`GET /ssh-key`, shown under **Servers → Connect a custom server**) must already be in the `authorized_keys` of `username`; SpinupWP removes it once provisioning is done. Creating the server waits until provisioning finishes. Destroying it removes the server from SpinupWP only; the machine is left alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SpinupWP's SSH key must be in root's authorized_keys before the server is created
resource "spinupwp_server" "example" {
  hostname       = "my-server"
  ip_address     = "203.0.113.10"
  provider_name  = "Example Hosting"
  ubuntu_version = "26.04"
}

resource "spinupwp_site" "example" {
  server_id           = tonumber(spinupwp_server.example.id)
  domain              = "example.com"
  site_user           = "example"
  installation_method = "blank"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname SpinupWP sets on the server: letters, numbers, dashes and periods. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IPv4 or IPv6 address SpinupWP connects to. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `provider_name` (String) Name of the hosting company, shown in SpinupWP, e.g. `Example Hosting`. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `ubuntu_version` (String) Ubuntu version installed on the server, one of the two latest LTS releases, e.g. `26.04`. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `database_root_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) MySQL root password. Write-only: never stored in state. SpinupWP generates one if unset. Only used when the server is provisioned.
- `post_provision_script` (String) Script SpinupWP runs as root once the server is provisioned. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `ssh_port` (Number) SSH port. Defaults to `22`. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `timezone` (String) Server timezone, e.g. `America/Toronto`. Defaults to SpinupWP's (UTC). Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.
- `username` (String) User SpinupWP connects as. Defaults to `root`. Changing it replaces the server, which provisions it again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server ID.
- `name` (String) Server name in SpinupWP.
- `status` (String) Server status reported by SpinupWP, e.g. `provisioned`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a server by its SpinupWP server ID.
terraform import spinupwp_server.example 12345
```
